about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Dedication of the Archbasilica of the Most Holy Savior” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech You, almighty God, that in this place which we, all unworthy, have dedicated to Your name, You will give a favorable hearing to all who petition You. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
